subject: general
question: Rauf and Hikat are the dance forms of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Rauf and Hikat is a folk dance associated with the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Apart from this, other folk dances of Jammu and Kashmir include Damali, Hikat, Mandjas, etc.
